cases.rationale: Two actual people face an open laptop; its integrated screen and keyboard establish laptop and keyboard. The furniture surface is a work desk, not an identifiable dining table. The small blue-black object below the desk could be a chair seat, but its partial shape does not establish a chair, so chair is unclear. People and objects in the wall photographs or laptop display are excluded depictions. The loose papers and cables do not establish books, a mouse, a remote or a phone. I considered each of the 75 definitions against the whole crop; the remaining explicitly no categories lack identifiable actual objects or parts.

Two actual zebras lower their striped heads toward the ground, with identifiable striped bodies, legs and manes. Their zebra identity excludes horse and the other animal alternatives. The remaining crop contains ground, a wooden fence and unpotted vegetation. I considered all 75 exact definitions, including small objects and parts; none of the other categories is visibly identifiable. There is no unresolved category ambiguity.

An open laptop has an identifiable integrated keyboard, and an actual light-colored computer mouse is cut by the lower edge. The desk is a computer work surface rather than a dining table. A slim pale device propped to the laptop's left could be a handset, but it is too indistinct to establish a mobile phone rather than another desktop device or landline handset; cell phone remains unclear. Loose papers, cables and dark accessories do not identify bound books, remotes or drinking vessels. The screen image is excluded. I considered each of the 75 frozen definitions and explicitly judged the other categories no.

The seated woman and surrounding pedestrians are actual people. The long slatted seat extending to the right of the woman is an identifiable bench. The stroller's frame and wheels are not a bicycle, and the large placard is not a traffic stop sign. Dark material on the woman's lap could include a handbag, but it merges with clothing and lacks a determinate bag body or handle, so handbag is unclear. No backpack or suitcase is identifiable. I inspected the whole crop against all 75 definitions, with the remaining categories explicitly no.

The crop shows a pile of actual yellow-brown bananas, including recognizable curved fruit and peels. The narrow white vessel rim along the right edge does not show enough of its profile to distinguish a bowl from a shallow plate or serving dish, so bowl is unclear. It does not establish a cup or vase. No dining-table context is visible around this close crop. I considered each of the 75 exact definitions, including all food alternatives, and found no other identifiable category objects.

A long yellow lifeguard rescue craft rests on its side at the water's edge, with a blue central surface or recess, perimeter handles and a strap. The visible construction leaves its identity unresolved between a rescue surfboard and a small kayak-like watercraft, so surfboard and boat both remain unclear. The beach and water alone do not resolve that distinction. It is not a snowboard or skateboard, and no person or animal is identifiable. I considered every one of the 75 definitions over the entire crop; all other categories are explicitly no.

An actual child leans toward a decorated cake on a red-covered eating/celebration table. The human-shaped cake topper is a figurine and supplies no additional actual person. The black background instrument has piano keys, which are excluded from computer keyboard; its paper is not an identifiable bound book, and it is not a microwave or monitor. A small curved furniture-like piece at the far left behind the cake could be a chair back but is insufficiently visible, so chair is unclear. I considered all 75 exact definitions; no other actual category object is identifiable.

A real black dog holds an identifiable red flying disc in its mouth. The red neckwear is a collar with tags, not a necktie. The yard contains grass, fencing and a house. A tiny pale object by the house at the right is too indistinct to distinguish a chair from a utility or other yard object, so chair is unclear. No actual person, other animal, bottle or sporting board is identifiable. I explicitly considered each of the 75 frozen definitions and judged the remaining categories no.

A large actual dark bear stands in profile, with identifiable bear head, muzzle, ears, shaggy body and paws. It is an animal rather than a teddy bear, costume or statue. The surroundings are an enclosure fence, rockwork and bare ground; no actual human or additional category object is visible. I considered all 75 definitions individually against the whole crop. There is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Several actual people sit on individual dining chairs around a white-clothed dining table with plates and glasses. Stemmed bowls with stems and feet establish wine glasses; small straight-sided drinking glasses establish cups. Necked bottles are identifiable on the rear bar shelves. Several small metallic utensils lie beside the plates, but the native crop does not resolve tines, cutting blades or spoon bowls reliably enough to assign fork, knife or spoon; those three remain unclear. The tall brown tabletop items are condiment mills rather than bottles. Food remnants do not identify any named fruit, vegetable or prepared-food category, and the upright paper card is not a book. I considered every one of the 75 definitions.

This workstation contains standalone computer monitors, a full computer keyboard, actual computer mice and part of an office chair in the lower foreground. A small clear necked bottle stands just left of the desk telephone. The telephone is a landline desk unit, not an identifiable cell phone. Small pale vessels beneath the central monitor and at the right could be drinking cups or storage holders, so cup remains unclear. Rectangular material on the upper-right shelving could include a bound book but cannot be distinguished reliably from paper or packaging, so book is unclear. The desks are work surfaces, not dining tables; pinned papers, posters and displayed screen content are excluded as depictions. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions, with all remaining categories no.

An orange rail tram runs across the foreground on tracks, a yellow-front road bus faces the viewer, and several passenger cars are visible between and beyond them. Actual pedestrians include the yellow-clad person at the crossing. Small dark pole-mounted fixtures around the distant junction are insufficiently detailed to identify a traffic-signal head, so traffic light is unclear. The other visible signs do not establish a stop sign or parking meter, and no truck or bicycle is identifiable. I considered each of the 75 frozen definitions across the whole crop, with all other categories explicitly no.
